options.text: Where can I find a bank?

3c044bbc-a0f4-4d8c-9655-da04712d408a.title: Lumbridge Guide
3c044bbc-a0f4-4d8c-9655-da04712d408a.text:
Hello there, adventurer! Is there anything I can help
you with?

7e8d7746-dbd3-4383-9b5e-53e542c6f98b.title: Lumbridge Guide
7e8d7746-dbd3-4383-9b5e-53e542c6f98b.text: Greetings, adventurer! I see that you're new here.

d8ed5f68-1a64-4c00-bef0-6b59c083809b.title: Lumbridge Guide
d8ed5f68-1a64-4c00-bef0-6b59c083809b.text:
My name is Phileas, but people often call me the
Lumbridge Guide.

6798db6c-137f-43e3-8645-d6ab6844b527.title: Lumbridge Guide
6798db6c-137f-43e3-8645-d6ab6844b527.text:
I'm always happy to give out tips to budding
adventurers. Is there anything I can help you with?

4b56da10-f728-4602-bb1f-9ce38470556d.title: Lumbridge Guide
4b56da10-f728-4602-bb1f-9ce38470556d.text:
It seems you're missing out on some valuable
experience. Would you like it?

bf1eca27-5b16-49fc-bcd7-5f73bef54cb6.text:
You are owed 500 Smithing XP and 500 Crafting XP
from Prince Ali Rescue.

558b70db-249f-44e4-af19-30ed3ae28785.text:
You are owed 500 Runecraft XP
from Rune Mysteries.

df8dfd83-f181-4ccd-8253-c028673e147f.text:
You are owed 1,000 Firemaking XP
from Clock Tower.

2fba17f9-9a12-407b-8cf0-8eaba09587d6.text:
You are owed 1,500 Woodcutting XP and 1,500 Crafting XP
from Lost City.

6659dabb-63ef-4fd5-9689-97b91ef36f27.title: <player>
6659dabb-63ef-4fd5-9689-97b91ef36f27.text: Where can I find a bank?

38472c5e-3dff-4057-8758-98a3cb86cc57.title: Lumbridge Guide
38472c5e-3dff-4057-8758-98a3cb86cc57.text:
Most towns have one. The one here in Lumbridge is on
the roof of the castle.
